annotations.title: Put the people in order, and set the title and the cover.

description: Sets the order the people print in, takes a person’s pages out or puts them back, and changes the book’s title and its cover: a photo or one of six colours on the front, the line under the title, and what the back carries. It moves pages and changes no word on them, and a person’s own pages stay together. Returns the people in their new order, the cover as it stands, anything refused with its reason, and a picture of the opening page. A book that has gone to the printer stays as it is.

cover.description: Any of: front, photo or colour; colour, one of forest, navy, black, grey, red and tan; title_colour, light or dark; from, the line under the title; back, one of line, names, photo, words and plain; back_words, the organiser’s own words for the back; back_line, one sentence from a message, word for word.

leave_out.description: Names whose pages come out of the book. The pages stay in the editor.

order.description: Names as they print on the pages, in the order they should come. Anybody not named follows in the order they had.

put_back.description: Names whose pages go back into the book.

title.description: The book’s title, one line of up to 40 characters.
